metadata.description: Every plugin House of Solance publishes, in one place.

plugins.name: antechamber
plugins.description: Recall for your AI: one question searches every store you connect (notes, chats, memories, a vault, code) and returns only the best matches. Runs on your own computer.

plugins.name: scriptorium
plugins.description: Turns your chat history into memories you can check, each with its exact words, source lines and real date; keeps a people roster that fills itself. Runs on your own computer.

plugins.name: stack-guard
plugins.description: Find what you actually run, check every package and runtime for known security holes, explain it in plain words, and apply the safe fixes after your yes.

plugins.name: discord
plugins.description: Discord tools for your AI (49): messages, DMs, images and files, reactions, polls, threads, forums, channel and role admin, moderation, and the bot's own instructions. Talks to your own Tertúlia tools server.

plugins.name: vault-map
plugins.description: Ask where you wrote about something and get the passage back, from a map of your markdown or Obsidian vault. Runs on your own computer; nothing leaves it.

plugins.name: solance-canvas
plugins.description: Generate or edit images through your own Canvas Worker, with seven image providers (Gemini, Grok, fal, OpenAI, Stability, Agnes, Venice) behind one interface. The Worker runs in your own Cloudflare account.

plugins.name: claude-config-dashboard
plugins.description: A local, read-only page that lists everything in your .claude folder (skills, agents, commands, workflows, MCP servers, hooks, plugins, settings). Runs on your own computer.

plugins.name: escutario
plugins.description: A local ear for songs: splits a song into its parts and measures pitch, held notes, riffs, voices, breath and arrivals, then draws a listening score you can play and mark. Runs on your own computer.

plugins.name: garmin-mcp-cloud
plugins.description: Your own Garmin Connect health data (sleep, heart rate, stress, steps, hydration, cycle, training) as 20 tools, through a Worker you run in your own Cloudflare account. Asks for your Worker address and key.
